about.title: About
about.does: Tell you when to visit a place you already chose, from today through seven days ahead.
about.how: We start from the usual flow for that weekday and scale it with a calendar ratio. Recommended hours come from that forecast and from how active the place usually is.
about.flags: What is on, and what is still in preparation (as of today)
about.limits: Live counts cover 121 places. We do not recommend holiday periods around Seollal and Chuseok. Station-area estimates are experimental.
about.sources: Sources: Seoul real-time city data, and holiday dates from the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute. Public Nuri.
about.flagsNote: The same setting on two rows means its state differs by place. On public holidays every station area is off.
